name: Maria Elisabetha Christmann
bioAdditions: Her baptism is now read in the original Reichenbach Lutheran register (page 115, 1729): under 9 August, Jacob Christmann of Kollweiler and his wife Anna Margaretha had a daughter born, baptized on the 14th (9th Sunday after Trinity), and named Maria Elisabetha; the godparents included a Conrad ... of Nanzweiler and a Maria Elisabetha (S1). This confirms the 9 August 1729 birth and gives her mother's first name, Anna Margaretha. FamilySearch calls the mother 'Anna Margarethe Raab' and gives the parents' marriage as 24 Nov 1722 at Kollweiler (S2); the surname Raab is not in the baptism entry and is unverified.
